boreal_lake_island_preintake.system: 42 true boreal lake islands across six lakes in northern Saskatchewan
boreal_lake_island_preintake.endpoint_scope: standardized 30x30m local island-plot assemblage occurrence, not complete whole-island occupancy

ecological_rationale: This system can test v0.55 in a disturbance-structured true-island setting because fire history, area, mainland isolation and habitat amount can be represented before asking whether internal occupied-source geometry adds heldout information.
next_valid_scientific_event: freeze safe metadata schemas/column roles and response-independent geometry for the boreal lake-island system without opening any species matrix; only a clean response-sealed design may advance to v0.11
